entries.title: I Samuel 20:1
segments: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?

entries.title: I Samuel 20:2
segments: And he said unto him, Far from it; thou shalt not die: behold, my father doeth nothing either great or small, but that he discloseth it unto me; and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:3
segments: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father knoweth well that I have found favor in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as Jehovah liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:4
segments: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:5
segments: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to-morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:6
segments: If thy father miss me at all, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth-lehem his city; for it is the yearly sacrifice there for all the family.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:7
segments: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be wroth, then know that evil is determined by him.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:8
segments: Therefore deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of Jehovah with thee: but if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?

entries.title: I Samuel 20:9
segments: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?

entries.title: I Samuel 20:10
segments: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me if perchance thy father answer thee roughly?

entries.title: I Samuel 20:11
segments: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:12
segments: And Jonathan said unto David, Jehovah, the God of Israel, [be witness]: when I have sounded my father about this time to-morrow, [or] the third day, behold, if there be good toward David, shall I not then send unto thee, and disclose it unto thee?

entries.title: I Samuel 20:13
segments: Jehovah do so to Jonathan, and more also, should it please my father to do thee evil, if I disclose it not unto thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and Jehovah be with thee, as he hath been with my father.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:14
segments: And thou shalt not only while yet I live show me the lovingkindness of Jehovah, that I die not;

entries.title: I Samuel 20:15
segments: but also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever; no, not when Jehovah hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:16
segments: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, [saying], And Jehovah will require it at the hand of David's enemies.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:17
segments: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had to him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:18
segments: Then Jonathan said unto him, To-morrow is the new moon: and thou wilt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:19
segments: And when thou hast stayed three days, thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:20
segments: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:21
segments: And, behold, I will send the lad, [saying], Go, find the arrows. If I say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee; take them, and come; for there is peace to thee and no hurt, as Jehovah liveth.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:22
segments: But if I say thus unto the boy, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way; for Jehovah hath sent thee away.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:23
segments: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, Jehovah is between thee and me for ever.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:24
segments: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat food.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:25
segments: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul's side: but David's place was empty.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:26
segments: Nevertheless Saul spake not anything that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:27
segments: And it came to pass on the morrow after the new moon, [which was] the second [day], that David's place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to-day?

entries.title: I Samuel 20:28
segments: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth-lehem:

entries.title: I Samuel 20:29
segments: and he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me [to be there]: and now, if I have found favor in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he is not come unto the king's table.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:30
segments: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of a perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own shame, and unto the shame of thy mother's nakedness?

entries.title: I Samuel 20:31
segments: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:32
segments: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore should he be put to death? what hath he done?

entries.title: I Samuel 20:33
segments: And Saul cast his spear at him to smite him; whereby Jonathan knew that is was determined of his father to put David to death.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:34
segments: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:35
segments: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:36
segments: And he said unto his lad, Run, find now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:37
segments: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?

entries.title: I Samuel 20:38
segments: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:39
segments: But the lad knew not anything: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:40
segments: And Jonathan gave his weapons unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:41
segments: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of [a place] toward the South, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.

entries.title: I Samuel 20:42
segments: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of Jehovah, saying, Jehovah shall be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed, for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
